title: Concurrent Node.stop can abort initial fragmentation yet transmit reports success
description: Security/lifecycle review of python/src/lichen/node.py found _transmit_peer_schc registers a session and awaits the initial radio batch before creating its driver, while stop/_cancel_fragment_sessions may cancel that same sender concurrently. If stop cancels during the final awaited link.send and it returns true, _transmit_peer_schc observes sender.status != active and returns True even though stop emitted Sender-Abort and no retransmission lifecycle remains. Serialize initial activation with shutdown or track an explicit cancellation outcome, prevent post-stop fragment sends, and add an interleaving regression proving the caller receives False and no driver/session survives.
